semantics.root_rule: `export` is a command-family namespace root and non-executable by default.
semantics.family_rule: Intermediate nodes such as `export.files` may be non-executable family nodes.
semantics.concrete_rule: Concrete descendants such as `export.files.json` are explicit executable command nodes.
semantics.extension_rule: Future families may include files, images, audio, video, code and other declared modalities without flattening the namespace.
semantics.semantic_rule: Command namespace structure does not redefine export semantic profiles.
semantics.authority_rule: Export discovery grants no source/export authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

hard_gates.condition: new modality steals existing command identity
